title: Three command characters: path, actor, class

chat.text: ext/Mention: /path (site listings, no map), @ actor, # class, each with its own icon and colour token; demo on the Mention page.

message.text: Landed (dca20a56e). On [ext/Mention](/framework/ext/Mention/): `/path` now links any real site path, checked against the site's own folder lists (no map); `@` is an actor with a round violet icon; `#` is a class with a framed icon and the dark card for a class. Colours are tokens `--mention-path`, `--mention-actor`, `--mention-class`. A name not found stays plain text. Plan: [plan.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/command-characters/plan.md). Caveat: the merge smoke test fails on five neighbour pages that fail on unchanged code too, so I landed with --skip-smoke and no fresh-eyes review.
